Everywhere else it stays at or below background: non-member vocabulary in ordinary prose (steel cabinet, wooden beams, silent desert, small children, river, door, poem) sits at 0.0-0.4, and the same member words in predicate or bare-noun position (the exam was hard, the door was open, the chemical was stored, the bar closed) stay at 0.8-1.7, below 60% of peak, so 'predicted inactive' means prose with no member token in attributive/stem position.
